title: Feature request: Support for LiteOS (HUAWEI Watch GT 2e or Honor MagicWatch 2)
symptom: User wants to see blood sugar on a smartwatch but finds WearOS too battery hungry, and watches from Huawei and Honor with LiteOS last longer. They request support for these watches.
evidence_quote: It is very unlikely that we will find time to support this watch, especially we don't have the hardware to test it. Hence, closing this issue.
